resources.string: Downloading the translation model (first time only)…
No text to translate on this screen.
Tap a box to see the original and the full translation. Tap outside to go back to the game.
By default it shows up only in Japanese games. Reads the screen with an OCR and translates with Google Translate online, or on the device when offline.
Asking the AI to read and translate…
AI translation unavailable (%1$s); used the regular translation.
Tip: download the Japanese game OCR in Settings › Screen translation to read this text much better.
the Gemini key reached its usage limit, try again in a minute
the Gemini key was refused, check it in Settings
the model \"%1$s\" doesn\'t exist or isn\'t available for this key
MeikiOCR, trained on video game text: reads pixel fonts and dialogue boxes far better. Download of about %1$d MB.
The best quality: the AI sees the screen, fixes what the OCR misread and translates with the game\'s context. Needs your own free key.
Create a free key in Google AI Studio and paste it here. The screenshot of the game goes to Google only when you tap Translate. Without a key, the app uses the regular translation.
